title: PETRv2: A Unified Framework for 3D Perception from Multi-Camera Images
venue: IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)

problem.summary: For temporal modeling, the main problem is how to align the object position of different frames in 3D space. Existing works [11, 20] solved this problem from the perspective of feature alignment.
statements: For temporal modeling, the main problem is how to align the object position of different frames in 3D space.
Existing works [11, 20] solved this problem from the perspective of feature alignment.

experiments.summary: The 3D PE achieves the temporal alignment on object position of different frames. PETRv2 achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3D object detection, BEV segmentation and 3D lane detection.

limitations.summary: Since PETR has demonstrated the effectiveness of 3D PE (encoding the 3D coordinates into 2D features) in 3D perception, we wonder if 3D PE still works on temporal alignment.
